# @sectile/dom API

Reference the public import paths exposed by @sectile/dom.

Start with the [@sectile/dom guide](/packages/dom) for usage and examples. This page is the lookup reference for exact public import paths.

## Install

```sh
pnpm add @sectile/dom
```
